mapper.select: SELECT a.arrange_id, a.course_id, a.tid, a.classroom, a.week_day, a.section, c.name AS course_name, t.name AS teacher_name FROM course_arrange a LEFT JOIN course c ON a.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON a.tid = t.tid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_arrange (course_id, tid, classroom, week_day, section) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{tid}, #{classroom}, #{weekDay}, #{section})
mapper.update: UPDATE course_arrange SET course_id = #{courseId}, tid = #{tid}, classroom = #{classroom}, week_day = #{weekDay}, section = #{section} WHERE arrange_id = #{arrangeId}
